title: Cambiar el modelo económico
goal: Read how the crisis pushed governments toward import substitution industrialization -- tariff barriers, state investment in strategic industries -- as a deliberate break from the export model.

items: Explain the question the crisis forced governments to consider seriously.
Name what economists later called this new economic idea.
Describe what Brazil, Mexico and Argentina began doing instead of waiting for demand to recover.
Explain the new role the state assumed in the economy.
Use en lugar de + infinitive to describe a deliberate policy switch.
